name: Microgrid operator setpoint authority gate
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Accepts the assigned manual setpoint only from the authorized operating interface.
description: Accepts the assigned manual setpoint only from the authorized operating interface. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Operator request and ownership” at the input and “Authorized setpoint request” at the output. The resource limits still apply.
